archetypes.name: White-Green Kithkin
archetypes.plan: Build around Wizened Cenn: Curve out with Kithkin, strengthen the whole team with tribal bonuses, and keep pressure on slower decks through combat.

archetypes.name: White-Blue Merfolk
archetypes.plan: Build around Summon the School: Develop a wide Merfolk board, tap creatures for value, and recur the token maker to win a longer game.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Faeries
archetypes.plan: Build around Dreamspoiler Witches: Play at instant speed, disrupt opposing turns, and let evasive Faeries convert tempo into steady damage.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Goblins
archetypes.plan: Build around Mad Auntie: Trade Goblins freely, recur useful bodies, and use tribal bonuses and removal to keep attacks profitable.

archetypes.name: Red-White Giants
archetypes.plan: Build around Thundercloud Shaman: Use early interaction and cost reduction to reach large Giants, then turn their size and arrival effects into control of combat.

archetypes.name: Black-Green Elves
archetypes.plan: Build around Imperious Perfect: Accumulate Elf tokens and tribal payoffs, use black removal to clear blockers, and overwhelm the battlefield.

archetypes.name: Five-Color Elementals
archetypes.plan: Build around Incandescent Soulstoke: Use Elemental mana fixing to cast threats across colors, then exploit tribal bonuses and temporary creatures for explosive turns.

archetypes.name: White-Black-Green Treefolk
archetypes.plan: Build around Doran, the Siege Tower: Fix three colors, defend with high-toughness Treefolk, and turn those defensive bodies into efficient attackers.
